verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers payroll data verification before running payroll, fringe benefits recording, PTO policies, and integrations, but contains no mention of cancelling, voiding, or correcting a payroll run that has already been submitted before employees are paid. Missing for 10: documentation of a payroll cancellation/void workflow, correction process for submitted-but-unpaid runs, and any UI/API support for reversing a submitted payroll.
